examples.look_at_obj_in_light:
Task: Look at creditcard 1 under the light of desklamp 1.
THOUGHT: I need to pick up the credit card.
ACTION: go to sidetable 1
THOUGHT: The credit card is here.
ACTION: take creditcard 1 from sidetable 1
THOUGHT: I should carry it to the desk lamp.
ACTION: go to desk 1
THOUGHT: Using the lamp while holding the card completes the task.
ACTION: use desklamp 1
examples.pick_and_place_simple:
Task: Put apple 1 in/on diningtable 1.
THOUGHT: I need to find and pick up the apple first.
ACTION: go to countertop 1
THOUGHT: The apple is here, so I should take it.
ACTION: take apple 1 from countertop 1
THOUGHT: I am holding it and can go to the destination.
ACTION: go to diningtable 1
THOUGHT: Placing the apple completes the task.
ACTION: put apple 1 in/on diningtable 1
examples.pick_clean_then_place_in_recep:
Task: Clean plate 1 and put it in/on cabinet 1.
THOUGHT: First I need the plate.
ACTION: go to countertop 1
THOUGHT: I can take the plate now.
ACTION: take plate 1 from countertop 1
THOUGHT: The sink basin can clean what I am holding.
ACTION: go to sinkbasin 1
THOUGHT: I should clean the plate before placing it.
ACTION: clean plate 1 with sinkbasin 1
THOUGHT: Now I need to reach and open the cabinet.
ACTION: go to cabinet 1
THOUGHT: The closed cabinet must be opened.
ACTION: open cabinet 1
THOUGHT: The clean plate can now be placed.
ACTION: put plate 1 in/on cabinet 1
examples.pick_cool_then_place_in_recep:
Task: Cool lettuce 1 and put it in/on countertop 1.
THOUGHT: First I need the lettuce.
ACTION: go to diningtable 1
THOUGHT: I can take the lettuce now.
ACTION: take lettuce 1 from diningtable 1
THOUGHT: The fridge can cool what I am holding.
ACTION: go to fridge 1
THOUGHT: I should cool the lettuce before placing it.
ACTION: cool lettuce 1 with fridge 1
THOUGHT: Now I can carry it to the destination.
ACTION: go to countertop 1
THOUGHT: Placing the cooled lettuce completes the task.
ACTION: put lettuce 1 in/on countertop 1
examples.pick_heat_then_place_in_recep:
Task: Heat apple 1 and put it in/on diningtable 1.
THOUGHT: First I need the apple.
ACTION: go to countertop 1
THOUGHT: I can take the apple now.
ACTION: take apple 1 from countertop 1
THOUGHT: The microwave can heat what I am holding.
ACTION: go to microwave 1
THOUGHT: I should heat the apple before placing it.
ACTION: heat apple 1 with microwave 1
THOUGHT: Now I can carry it to the destination.
ACTION: go to diningtable 1
THOUGHT: Placing the heated apple completes the task.
ACTION: put apple 1 in/on diningtable 1
examples.pick_two_obj_and_place:
Task: Put two apples in/on diningtable 1.
THOUGHT: I need to move the first apple.
ACTION: go to countertop 1
THOUGHT: I can take the first apple.
ACTION: take apple 1 from countertop 1
THOUGHT: I should place it before collecting the second one.
ACTION: go to diningtable 1
THOUGHT: This places the first apple.
ACTION: put apple 1 in/on diningtable 1
THOUGHT: I need to return for the second apple.
ACTION: go to countertop 1
THOUGHT: I can take the second apple now.
ACTION: take apple 2 from countertop 1
THOUGHT: I should bring it to the same destination.
ACTION: go to diningtable 1
THOUGHT: Placing it completes the two-object task.
ACTION: put apple 2 in/on diningtable 1
